description: Robustness of the pathology null (Section 4.2 and Appendix I).
outcome_variable: marginal fusion utility of the higher-CKA minus the lower-CKA candidate, per fold

paired_t_15folds_pooled.note: treats folds as independent; overstates precision

cluster_robust_by_dataset.note: Primary figure reported in the paper. IMPORTANT: with G = 3 clusters the normal reference is anti-conservative. Under the conventional t(G-1) = t(2) reference the same standard error gives 95% CI [-1.00, +1.50], p = 0.48 -- which coincides with the dataset-means row below. Both are reported so the choice is visible.

cluster_robust_by_dataset_t_G_minus_1.note: Conservative small-G reference. Recommended as primary for a 3-cluster design.

equivalence_test.conclusion: Equivalence within +/-1 pp is established when folds are treated as independent but NOT at the dataset level (n=3). The paper states the weaker claim: the evidence is consistent with equivalence but does not establish it at n=3.
equivalence_test.caveat: The +/-1 pp equivalence margin is narrower than the t(2) cluster-robust interval ([-1.00, +1.50]), so equivalence within +/-1 pp is not supported under the conservative reference distribution. Statements of the form 'consistent with equivalence within +/-1 point' should be read against the fold-independent test only.

dose_response.note: Uses the FIXED-BASE general-vision values (general_vision_fixedbase.json). An earlier version of this file reported +0.278, computed on the superseded per-comparison-base results.

parameter_free_fusion.note: The null does not depend on the class-conditional fusion rule.
